5.a) Define biodiversity. Give various levels of biodiversity. 3 3 3

Ans. Biodiversity is the variety and variability of life on Earth. It means “the existence of al
large number of different kinds of animals and plants which make a balanced
environment”

Biodiversity is usually considered at three different levels
1. Genetic diversity
The variety of genes within a given species
Genetic diversity is the diversity within species ie.,
variation of genes within the species. eg.,rice varieties.

teak wood trees : Incian teak,ourma teak,maiasian
teak.

~h phe

2. Species diversity
The variety of species in a given ecosystem.
Diversity is greatest when all the species present are equally abundant in the area.

A large number of plants, animals and microorganisms interact with each other in a
ecosystem.
